best_for: Java developers and ops teams who need a free, certified JDK 21 for building and running apps, without Oracle's license terms.

points.title: Certified OpenJDK, no fees
points.text: Temurin is Eclipse Adoptium's build of OpenJDK. It passes the Java SE TCK and the AQAvit quality tests, and costs nothing. The license is GPLv2 with the Classpath Exception, so your own code is not affected.

points.title: JDK 21 is supported to at least 2029
points.text: Adoptium lists Java 21 LTS as available until at least December 2029. JDK 25 is the newer LTS, supported to at least September 2031, if you are starting fresh.

points.title: Quarterly security updates
points.text: Updates follow OpenJDK's schedule: usually the third Tuesday of January, April, July and October. Out-of-cycle fixes get a four-part version number.

points.title: Community support only, unless you pay someone
points.text: Free help comes through GitHub issues and the community Slack. Adoptium points to commercial support providers for anyone who needs a contract.

points.title: x64 only on Windows here
points.text: The Windows MSI installs for all users and is x64 only. macOS packages come for Intel and Apple Silicon. The Windows listing keeps 16 versions; macOS lists only the current release.
